newsitem.title: SPAIN: No reason Spain won't meet EMU criteria - BoS's Rojo.
newsitem.headline: No reason Spain won't meet EMU criteria - BoS's Rojo.

text.p: Bank of Spain governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Tuesday there was no reason Spain would not fulfil the criteria for the launch of Europe's single currency.
"There is no reason why they wouldn't be fulfilled," Rojo said in an address to the annual meeting of the Inter-American Development Bank. "And this is not an overly optimistic view."
Rojo said Spain was already fulfilling criteria on exchange rates and long-term interest rates, and that the inflation outlook was very favourable. Debt should decline this year.
As to the narrowing of the deficit, "the government is in condition to do it," Rojo said. "There are reasons to be relatively optimistic.
He added that being left outside would put Spain in a difficult position.
